# UI/UX Pro Max Design Intelligence Skill for Muse

A searchable local design-intelligence database for UI/UX work: 79 searchable styles, 192 product palettes with reasoning profiles, 74 font pairings, 119 UX guidelines, 105 curated icons, 17 GSAP presets, 25 chart types, and 22 technology stacks — queried offline via a bundled Python script (`--domain`, `--stack`, `--design-system` modes). It enforces a priority-ordered rule system (accessibility and touch/interaction first), stack detection instead of guessing, design-system generation with optional persistence, and optional 1–10 "design dials" (variance, motion, density). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: a guidance database, not a generator — it tells Muse what good looks like; you still build the UI yourself. Requires Python 3 locally (no external dependencies). Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
